graph.name: FUTURA '26 - GEC Wayanad TechFest
graph.tagline: Innovate for the Hills, Code for the Globe
graph.description: Annual national technology festival of Government Engineering College Wayanad, bringing together coders, roboticists, innovators, and thinkers to tackle real-world challenges through sustainable technology.

graph.name: Hackathon: HackTheHills 2026
graph.description: A 24-hour team-based programming and rapid prototyping challenge addressing disaster resilience, eco-tourism, and edge computing for rural ecosystems.
graph.venue: CSE Advanced Computing Lab & Central Computing Centre
graph.coordinator: Dr. Alice A & Student Lead Arjun K

graph.name: Introduction to Federated AI & Edge Deployments
graph.description: Hands-on, project-driven workshop on training privacy-preserving machine learning models and deploying lightweight inference engines on Raspberry Pi and ESP32 edge hardware.
graph.instructor: Prof. Bob B (IIIT Bangalore Alum & Senior Research Associate)

graph.name: Building Scalable Products from Ideas: Kerala to Silicon Valley
graph.description: A fireside conversation and interactive AMA with Y-Combinator alumni and deep-tech startup founders sharing frameworks on product-market fit, technical architecture, and open-source monetization.
graph.speaker: Rohan Menon (Founder & CEO, NeuralStream AI)

graph.name: RoboRumble: All-Terrain Robot Challenge
graph.description: Combat and obstacle-course navigation arena designed to test custom-built wired and wireless rovers tackling sand pits, inclined bridges, and water puddles.

graph.name: CodeSprint: Speed Coding & Algorithmic Duel
graph.description: Fast-paced, multi-round competitive programming contest testing dynamic programming, graph theory, mathematical logic, and code optimization against strict time limits.

graph.name: Cloud Native & Kubernetes Microservices Mastery
graph.description: Architecting resilient microservices using Docker containers, Helm charts, Envoy proxies, and automated Kubernetes multi-cluster rollouts on Google Cloud.

graph.name: CyberSiege: 8-Hour CTF (Capture The Flag)
graph.description: Jeopardy-style offensive and defensive cybersecurity tournament spanning binary exploitation, web vulnerabilities, reverse engineering, cryptography, and digital forensics.

graph.name: Geospatial AI & Remote Sensing for Mountain Terrain Disaster Mitigation
graph.description: Case study review on utilizing radar satellite imagery, LiDAR point clouds, and geospatial neural networks to forecast landslide hazards across the Western Ghats region.
graph.speaker: Dr. K. S. Radhakrishnan (Director of Geological Remote Sensing, ISRO)

graph.title: Grand Inauguration Ceremony & Keynote Address
graph.speaker: Principal & Chief Guest from Tech Industry

graph.speaker: Prof. Bob B

graph.title: Workshop: Cloud Native & Kubernetes Microservices Mastery

graph.title: Valedictory Function, Prize Distribution & Cultural Pro-Show

graph.title: HackTheHills 2026 Problem Tracks Announced
graph.content: Problem statements for Disaster Management, Sustainable Agritech, and Smart Campus Solutions are now released on the portal. Participants should verify their team registration by 9 PM tonight.

graph.title: ECE Seminar Hall Venue Relocation Notice
graph.content: The Federated AI workshop will now be hosted in ECE Seminar Hall Block B (Ground Floor) to accommodate additional hardware testbeds.

graph.title: Free Shuttle Service for Outstation Participants
graph.content: Complimentary college bus shuttles will be operating between Mananthavady KSRTC Bus Stand and GEC Wayanad campus every 45 minutes between 7:30 AM and 10:00 PM on all festival days.

graph.title: Spot Registrations for CyberSiege CTF
graph.content: Due to overwhelming demand, 5 additional team slots have been enabled for CyberSiege CTF. Check the registration desk at Network Security Lab.
